parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry is_test=true and reside in Shared/Playback/Tests/PlaybackTests/Behavior/PlayerControllerBehaviorTests.swift within the Playback package. Although the two methods — StopBehaviorTests.stopIsIdempotent (line 214) and StopBehaviorTests.playAfterStopWorks (line 234) — share a high structural similarity (Jaccard 0.78), they are distinct behavioral test cases exercising different stop-related scenarios and their near-duplicate shape is expected for test methods that share setup/teardown boilerplate. Merging or extracting them would obscure test intent and couple unrelated behavioral assertions.
